messages:
Maya: quick thought: Console needs a tiny "who changed this" view for routing rules during rollouts — not full export, just recent breadcrumbs.
Owen: yes. customers want rule -> actor -> canary id -> revert link, immediate.
Priya: prefer a /audit/preview endpoint returning compact events (actor_id, display_name, verb, rollout_id, diff_snippet, redacted). cache for 20s.
Maya: UI will show "Recent changes (preview)" with a "Request full audit" CTA that kicks off an async export job.
Owen: exports must return presigned_url + manifest(signed_by + checksum) for legal proof.
Priya: sampling: free tier gets 100 previews/day/project, then rate-limited. add X-Preview-Quota-Remaining header.
infra-bot: note: created ticket PLT-10101 for preview+export API, add metrics audit.preview.requests and audit.export.jobs.
Maya: also propose a gated WS /audit/tail for Dedicated tenant-admins only.
Owen: agree. separate endpoints makes quota enforcement easier than overloading /exports.
Priya: I'll draft the proto and share payload examples.
